subject.title: feat: Control UI debug mode — ephemeral connection logs and error details

question: What pre-auth Control UI connection details may be shown and copied in a session-only diagnostic drawer?
rationale: The implementation boundary is clear enough, but exposing handshake/device/auth/close data before authentication creates a disclosure and support-export policy choice that automation should not decide.

options.title: Approve sanitized session diagnostics
options.body: Allow an opt-in in-memory drawer that captures only a maintained redacted event schema and copy payload for failed connection flows.

options.title: Limit to existing categorized errors
options.body: Keep the current login-gate guidance and raw redacted error details, and decline pre-auth timeline logging for now.

options.title: Require authenticated-only diagnostics
options.body: Permit richer logs only after a successful operator connection via Debug/Logs pages, leaving pre-auth failures to structured error messages.

recommendation.title: Approve sanitized session diagnostics
recommendation.body: Allow an opt-in in-memory drawer that captures only a maintained redacted event schema and copy payload for failed connection flows.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current history on the login-gate and gateway-auth Control UI surface where the product/security choice would land.
